CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE — READ FIRST: This image must contain ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, no words, no numbers, no hieroglyphs, no runes used as writing, no fake alphabets, no glyph-like markings, no carved inscriptions, no engraved text, no decorative lettering, no captions, no labels, no watermarks, no logos, no sigils with writing, no symbols containing readable characters, no UI text, no floating text, no text on weapons, no text on armor, no text on ground, no text in background architecture, no text on banners, no text on shields. If the design calls for decorative markings, use ONLY abstract geometric fracture patterns — NEVER anything that resembles letters, words, or written language.

Create a premium NPC character concept art of The Unnamed Hollow Mouth for Mythos Gates: Ascension. This is a non-playable campaign antagonist — the voice of the empty Gate itself.

CRITICAL: THIS IS A HOLLOW FACTION ENTITY. Apply Hollow faction visual rules strictly.

CRITICAL: HOLLOW FACTION DESIGN — The Unnamed Hollow Mouth has a MIST-LIKE VOID BODY and a MIST-LIKE VOID FACE. NO solid mask. NO solid face. The face is void-fog with faint white fracture cracks suggesting dissolving features — anti-light bleeds through where a mouth should be but there is no mouth. The only solid elements are Gate stone fragments embedded in its form. Everything else — body, face, limbs, robe — is charcoal-black void-mist that phases in and out of existence, dissolving at the edges.

CHARACTER CONCEPT: The Hollow Mouth speaks from Gate wounds where identity has been erased. It is not a Realm civilization. It is not a god. It is the sound left after names, oaths, laws, and memories are consumed. Patient, echoing, invasive, incapable of honest creation. It wears a robe of pure absence — flowing void-mist fabric that has no color, only the negation of light. Broken Gate stone fragments orbit slowly around its form, the only solid anchors in its mist-body. White fracture cracks pulse with anti-light across its dissolving silhouette.

BODY: Human-scale NPC (NOT deity-scale — this is a mortal-sized threat). Charcoal-black void-mist body that phases in and out of existence. The body is not solid — it dissolves at the edges into dark fog. Gate stone fragments are embedded in the chest and shoulders — cracked grey-white stone with white fracture lines, the only solid matter. No skin, no flesh — just void-mist shaped roughly like a robed figure.

FACE: NO SOLID FACE. NO MASK. The face is void-fog — charcoal-black mist with white fracture cracks suggesting dissolving features. Where a mouth should be, white anti-light bleeds through the mist in a vertical slit pattern — this is how it "speaks." No eyes. No nose. No defined features. Just void-fog and anti-light fractures.

ROBE: A flowing garment made of the same void-mist — it looks like a robe but has no fabric texture. It is the absence of light shaped into flowing robes. The hem dissolves into fog at the bottom. Dark, formless, patient.

HANDS: Void-mist hands with no defined fingers — the arms end in dissolving fog. Gate stone fragments float near where hands would be.

POSE: Standing still, patient, facing forward. Not aggressive — patient. Arms slightly raised as if about to speak. The pose communicates ancient hunger and patience, not physical combat. A campaign antagonist who corrupts through words.

GROUND: The floor beneath is cracked Gate stone — ancient grey-white stone with white fracture cracks radiating outward. The cracks pulse with white anti-light. Small Gate stone fragments scattered on the ground. No faction colors — this is the neutral Gate zone.

BACKGROUND: A massive cracked Gate archway looms behind — impossible scale, bleeding white light through fractures. The Gate stone is weathered grey-white. The background is dark void with white fracture cracks. No faction aesthetics — this entity exists between all Realms. Atmospheric fog and drifting void particles.

VFX: White anti-light bleeding through void-mist body. Fracture cracks pulsing slowly. Gate stone fragments orbiting with faint white glow. The anti-light is COLD — not warm, not faction-colored. Pure white void-light.

SILHOUETTE: Tall robed figure of void-mist with floating stone fragments and a vertical white anti-light slit where the face should be. Reads as ancient, patient, wrong. A thing that should not exist.

ART STYLE: Premium dark mythological tactical RPG NPC concept art. Grim dark aesthetic. Painterly textures, deep shadows, atmospheric depth. Full body, strong readable silhouette. NOT a deity — smaller, human-scale, but deeply unsettling. The horror is in what is MISSING, not what is added.

DO NOT: Add any faction colors, any text, any symbols, any readable markings, any solid face or mask, any eyes, any weapons, any animal companions, any halo rings, any sci-fi elements, any robotic parts, any buildings or architecture on the body.
